name: Solar
summary: A mighty angel that wields a flying sword and slaying bow, aids allies, and takes legendary actions.

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.text: The solar knows if it hears a lie.

traits.name: Exalted Restoration
traits.text: If the solar dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: If the solar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The solar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The solar makes two Flying Sword attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Slaying Bow.

actions.name: Flying Sword
actions.onHit: *Hit or Miss:* The sword magically returns to the solar's hand or hovers within 5 feet of the solar immediately after a ranged attack.

actions.name: Slaying Bow

save.targets: one creature the solar can see within 600 feet

actions.onFailure: If the creature has 100 Hit Points or fewer, it dies. It otherwise takes {dmg:4d8+dex:piercing} plus {dmg:8d8:radiant}.

bonusActions.name: Divine Aid
bonusActions.text: The solar casts *{ref:spell/cure-wounds}* (level 2 version), *{ref:spell/lesser-restoration}*, or *{ref:spell/remove-curse}*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

legendaryActions.intro: Immediately after another creature's turn, the solar can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The solar regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

items.name: Blinding Gaze

save.targets: one creature the solar can see within 120 feet

items.onFailure: The target has the Blinded condition for 1 minute.
items.onFailureOrSuccess: The solar can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Radiant Teleport
items.text: The solar teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* {dc:cha}, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the solar at its destination space. *Failure:* {dmg:2d10:radiant}. *Success:* Half damage.
